[Key Information from testbed/FoundationAgents__MetaGPT-485_2026-11-11_04-30-53/README.md]
- MetaGPT Installation Notes:
  - Requires Node.js (which includes npm) for installing mermaid-cli:
    - Check npm: `npm --version`
    - Install mermaid-cli globally: `sudo npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`
    - Alternative: install mermaid-cli locally: `npm install @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`
  - Requires Python 3.9+:
    - Check version: `python --version`
    - Clone repo and install MetaGPT:
      ```
      git clone https://github.com/geekan/metagpt
      cd metagpt
      pip install -e.
      ```
    - If permission error: `pip install -e. --user`
  - Optional dependencies for Mermaid chart conversion:
    - Playwright:
      ```
      pip install playwright
      playwright install --with-deps chromium
      ```
      Set in config.yaml: `MERMAID_ENGINE: playwright`
    - Pyppeteer:
      ```
      pip install pyppeteer
      export PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/path/to/chromium_or_edge_or_chrome
      ```
      Set in config.yaml: `MERMAID_ENGINE: pyppeteer`
    - Mermaid.ink (no pdf export support)
      Set in config.yaml: `MERMAID_ENGINE: ink`
  - Environment Variable:
    - To skip Chromium download: `export PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true`
  - Configuration files:
    - `config/key.yaml`, `config/config.yaml` for OpenAI API key and optional API base URL.
    - Priority order: `config/key.yaml > config/config.yaml > env variables`
    - Example setup:
      ```
      cp config/config.yaml config/key.yaml
      # Edit to add your OPENAI_API_KEY
      ```
  - Docker Option:
    - Pull official image: `docker pull metagpt/metagpt:latest`
    - Setup config and workspace on host, mount to container:
      ```
      mkdir -p /opt/metagpt/{config,workspace}
      docker run --rm metagpt/metagpt:latest cat /app/metagpt/config/config.yaml > /opt/metagpt/config/key.yaml
      vim /opt/metagpt/config/key.yaml # edit keys
      ```
    - Run container to execute MetaGPT commands:
      ```
      docker run --rm --privileged \
        -v /opt/metagpt/config/key.yaml:/app/metagpt/config/key.yaml \
        -v /opt/metagpt/workspace:/app/metagpt/workspace \
        metagpt/metagpt:latest \
        python startup.py "Write a cli snake game"
      ```
    - Can also run interactively with a named container and exec bash
  - Docker build from source:
    ```
    git clone https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.git
    cd MetaGPT
    docker build -t metagpt:custom .
    ```
